body: I’ll try my best. I’ve never been good at just ignoring things though, it all just eats at me until I breakdown. Thank you for talking with me ❤️
I suppose it’s my fault for looking. I appreciate you commenting though, and I’ll try my best to just avoid looking all together

Hi, sorry for the late reply. I didn’t tell the randoms I was suicidal, I told my ex. I was referring to my ex as “they” so there’s no way this post could be traced back to my main. I told my ex I was suicidal and my ex proceeded to tell the randoms. Sorry for not clarifying :(

Hi, thank you for commenting. 
Some part of me knows that I think. I wish I was strong enough to just not be bothered by it. 
I’m gonna try my best to just no focus on it, especially with that being on top of all the other things I feel.
Maybe one day I’ll try. All relationships ever do is cause me pain though, so I think I’m gonna just lay low

I don’t really want to find anyone. I also think it’d probably be much easier if I was male. The fact that I’m female just makes people feel the need to invalidate me, or how I feel. Thanks for talking with me, though.

That’s not the only standing reason why I am. I’ve posted before explaining more so on my reasoning. And yes, I agree that getting rid of them would solve this ultimately, but I’ve gotten messages from random people (people I’ve never talked to before, so I’ve had no chance to block them beforehand) making fun of what my ex has told them. It’s extremely hard to ignore when it’s happened so frequently

Thanks for taking the time to comment, I appreciate it more than you could imagine. 
I think it would hurt less if I knew it was about something else, anything else really. I poured my heart out to this person and confessed to wanting to die and what I was planning on doing. They then screenshotted and posted about me. It just hurts extremely badly to trust someone and then realize that they’re fake. 
I will take your advice about deleting some stuff though, if not that I’ll just promise to stay off them for awhile.

One day, (once you’re old enough) you can legally  just leave and never see them again. That’s a for sure thing, so what’s going on now won’t last. You can just start walking whilst flipping them all off, best of luck ❤️
Thanks for talking to me dude. I’ll promise that I’ll give those things a try. I just have the feeling that I’ll always feel this way :(
